facts.fact: The Ministry of Local Government's sector plan states that the integrated financial management information system (IFMIS) has been rolled out down to sector level and now covers sector offices, with all their financial and related transactions undertaken within the system, and credits it for unqualified audits of 25 of 28 districts and the City of Kigali (89.3%) in 2022/23; the roll-out is undated, so the plan's date of 14 November 2024 is used.

The Governance and Decentralisation Sector Strategic Plan 2024-2029, dated 14 November 2024, costs an intervention (3.7) to support local government entities with office space, furniture, ICT equipment and internet connectivity at 12,500,000 in its costing unit, spread over the first three years, and a further intervention to boost ICT infrastructure so that all local government entities have reliable technology.

The sector plan of 14 November 2024 names the Ministry of Local Government, RISA, the Ministry of ICT, the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Rwanda Housing Authority as responsible for the intervention giving local government entities ICT equipment and internet connectivity.
